review: I ordered my first pads in April, but as the confetti design was a backorder, this was the first chance I’ve had to leave a review based on more than just an impression (my period had just finished when they arrived.) The confetti design looked even better in person than they did online, so for anyone wavering, go for it.The pads are very comfortable to wear and I was disappointed when the last one went into the wash pile and it was back to disposables. Compared to disposables, I don’t even know when I am wearing a mega mega pad. Far, far less trousers etc went in the wash due to leaks, which was what had prompted the original decision to order. I am hopeful of getting this down further now knowing what pads to wear when and also having realised that unlike disposable winged pads, they don’t just have to stay where they naturally fit, they can adjusted to suit your flow.I have messaged Lauren with a few questions and always received responses swiftly. Wear Em Out put larger companies to shame. They also have the occasional free postage offer which is admirable for a small business. Annoyingly my cycle was such that I just missed the Jubilee one, but I ordered another trial pack (all I can afford right now) after using the first pads and the postage was very reasonable. I now plan to assess the pads longer term and then decide on future purchases. They did bobble slightly from the initial pre-wear wash and one seemed to have hitched on something during the production/distribution process, so time will tell how they hold up. I certainly couldn’t feel that they had bobbled while wearing them.

Around the house and on lazy days the pads are fine. But I found that on a short walk the ribbing chafed my upper thighs terribly. It took a week to heal. I have an active life and job and wanted to be able to confidently wear these all the time but the discomfort I experienced after an hour of gentle activity has made me nervous about wearing them for my daily activities such as cycling to work or at my job which is moderately active (think nursing, childcare, teaching etc).It should be noted that I have plus sized thighs- skinny legged humans might not find it so irritating. Pros- less bunching than disposables, no sticky wings, they seem breathable and soft against the skin on the non-popper side. Great that there are trial packs, it was worth a trial and I really wanted these to be my solution but  I think they might suit others more than me.

title: Lovely at first but not wearing well with time
review: I’m writing this review having used the pads for 3 period cycles now - I have purchased 5 in total. Firstly I want to say I’m very impressed with how the company are making reusable sanitary products cool and more mainstream. Secondly the pads do seem to work, I’ve had leakage a few times but otherwise all good. However whilst the pads were so soft and comfy the first time I used them after 2 months they started to go bobbly and now on month 3 are very bobbly and I think this will only get worse. title: Alarming approach and response to the BLM movement.
review: I approached the founder of this company in June responding to a Newsletter about Black Lives Matter which came 11 days following death of George Floyd and didn't get a response. I received another newsletter this October which prompted me to get in touch re my previous query. I added that I was interested in one of the products too. I received a response asking which email I was referring to, to which I responded, and quoted the part that I said that I did not understand (yet wished to) despite appreciating the honesty. The response (full direct quote) "oh ok it was just me learning about my white privilege" No other words or elaboration.The Black Lives Matter email features a number of things myself and fellow black women felt extremely uncomfortable, confused and offended by. I explain where myself, and other black woman had felt uncomfortable about the email that seemed to mostly be about proving that she is not racist, and also inserting a picture of her with a black person, and making a questionable statements accompanying it. She highlighted that she "never considered herself to be racist", "so nonchalant around race" by opening email highlighting that she supported a (black) friend in childbirth, whilst working in her role as a doula. I, and other black women felt it odd that she would open with this, highlight it (if nonchalant), and why race would matter in her role as doula (must be non-discriminatory) or friend and what about BLM movement connects the moment. You don't become not racist by supporting a black person/your friend in your work so I was unsure about the point of the statement and image, and why BLM provoked memory of this moment.The response to the email I made explaining the feelings it provoked amongst a number of black women was met with a response that we felt this way as we must have misunderstood.As above, I had asked twice for elaboration and clarification of the image and statement that accompanied it  - on the first instance, my email was "lost" (I still have it), and the second enquiry about it failed to elaborate. When I explained my thought and feelings, and how it made me feel as a black woman, feelings shared with other black women, I was told that we feel this way because we “I think you maybe you misunderstood the purpose of the photo and the message I was trying to relay?”Still, no explanation was made to support my understanding, and none of my points as to why it made us *feel* this way were addressed in any part of the email. I am black, the email was titled "Black Lives Matter" and the statements regarding race made me and other black people very very uncomfortable, but we feel this way because of a lack of understanding?Two posts were brought to my attention on the brand social media account, (one less than 15mins after my email) about people making flippant comments, a second – a post titled "on your marks, get set, go f*** yourself", which used phrases such as "be kind", and "online bullying", and spoke about people going out of their way to bring people down, and criticise them. It spoke about the anxiety faced posting things online in fear of unintentionally offending someone. It also said "there are people waiting for you to trip up so they can celebrate in your missteps and apply judgement and intentional offence. Don't ever be that person, don't seek pleasure in bringing down another, life is hard enough without hunting other opportunities to bring people down" This post was followed by a number of women sending well wishes, and "f the haters" etc. I commented on the post - which was then removed. The account was also taken down for 5 hours after I sent a message about the response, and updated post, and I was told that the post was not about me "THIS IS NOT ABOUT YOU", and was met with "sorry you feel that way" comments and "well what can I say?" and "ok thanks for your view, I'm gonna leave this conversation here as I don't feel you'd accept anything I had to say as anything other that what you decided it was" I decided? Black people feel uncomfortable with the peculiar statements in a Black Lives Matter newsletter and its "what you decided it was" Again, not able to explain what is was? Another response "mate I was in the middle of putting my kid to bed after a particularly s***ty day, I opened the email and response how I felt I could at that time, I can't say any more than that" and "well look I'm sorry I don't say the right thing or that it was a cop out, there's nothing more to say so I really am gonna leave this here - I won't be responding again" "Mate"?The post was then deleted, and then shortly business account deactivated for 5 hours after this message was sent, and that was it. I found this considerably unprofessional, and sad to see our thoughts and feelings from the race being discussed not being taken on board.

title: A mixed experience
review: When I received the lovely bag I ordered in the Black Friday deal which meant it was half price, I could immediately see that the zip had been put on upside down.  I rang Customer Service to explain the problem and they said I could send it back to them at no expense to myself which I did that morning.However I could see how popular this handbag was and therefore i was concerned that as the bag was faulty I didn't want to loose out so could they put one aside for me.  This isn't their policy.  One has to wait for the bag to be inspected once it is received before a decision is made as to offer a replacement.It took 3 days for the bag to arrive because of slow post office service it would appear, so I left it 2 days before ringing Customer Services again who informed me that indeed the zip was faulty but it had been repaired which I was rather surprised about and was I happy to receive this bag now everything was ok.As no more bags were available in this style I agreed and was delighted when the bag arrived 2 days later looking perfect.  However I do not agree with their policy when bags are faulty.  If the bag could not have been repaired then I would have lost out through no fault of my own.

title: Customer Services unable to help on order error minutes after order placed
review: This is just my experience from purchasing online.  The product itself is absolutely fine and no issues in terms of quality etc.  I purchased a handbag online and instantly received the confirmation email.  I checked this and quickly realised that in the order placing I have selected the wrong colour some how.  I wanted the 'ink' colour but seemed to have been processed with 'grey'.  I noticed within a couple of minutes of placing the order and I messaged on Whatsapp to ask customer services not to send and to exchange the product to the colour I wanted as the pricing was all the same.  I also emailed to make sure I gave every chance to change or refund the item as I didn't want a grey bag.  When I did get a reply, customer service said they could do nothing at all and proceeded to ship the bag anyway.  I cant believe there was no opportunity to change or offer an alternative than to ship something I said I didn't want, even though it was my mistake.  I still wanted the bag from them.  I would be happy to wait until the bag I wanted came in if it was out of stock.  I had no options and customer services seemed dismissive and carried on when an issue could have be corrected for the customer.

It’s not large in reality but I double checked the dimensions before I chose and it’s just the ticket. Big enough for my wallet in the front patch pocket and my ‘phone in rear, out of sight, zip pocket, plus of course the main compartment for other stuff. I gave 4 stars because the front patch pocket and main compartment zip arrived squashed and creased and I can’t come up with a way to undo that. Perhaps Roka could come up with a way to pad out the front pocket in particular for delivery. In general I love the handy size and lightweight fabric - better than my previous heavy one which made my neck ache.

title: Good product, fast shipping, misleading offer
review: Shipping was quick. The quality of the bags seem good so far. They advertise on their website banner that you can choose a bag, get 2 free straps and $100 off, but this is not actually the case. The promo code for this doesn't work (I've put in two different orders on two different dates).  I emailed customer support and basically the two "free" straps and "key ring" (ie the pom pom or tassel bag decoration) is the equivalent of $71 in value. So not a $100 discount, and I would say a misleading advertisement in their banner, and it's intended to create a sense of urgency in the buyer. I would prefer they were more up front about the promo - that if you order a cross body bag, you get two free straps, and that is an every day, standard offer.They just ship the stuffed bags in a dust bag and then into a plastic UPS bag. My bags did arrive unharmed, but I think that's not a lot of protection for the cross-continental journey.

title: Disappointing
review: I purchased a city bag last year. After 7 months of infrequent use the top zipper broke. Because the warranty is good for one year, they quickly replaced the bag. They claimed no changes were made but it was a significant difference. Maybe it was a returned or rejected item because it was a replacement. Regardless, I will not be purchasing from them again.

I have contacted them through live chat and twice on what’s App and this is their response ‘ We are still awaiting an update from our logistics department. we will inform you once there is an update’. title: Nordic Rucksack
review: I’ve had this for just over a year with almost daily use. Let’s start with positives. The rucksack is really well made and the materials are obviously high quality. Capacity is great for a day out with the side pockets and loops for other bits and bobs. It’s just a really nice pack. I would like to change the straps though. The chest clip really needs attaching to the side of the strap rather than the front. It causes the strap to twist and dig in making it uncomfortable. Ideally the buckles could do with the same quick release rather than the belt sort of fitting (no sure of the proper name!) many times these have come undone and the bag has fallen (once breaking a tablet screen that was in the bag, landed bang on the corner). The roll top straps could do with moving in a little, it’s easy for the canvas to come loose and unwind because they are so close to the edge. Would I recommend it? Yeah but only as a work/general bag.

When they arrived, the material was so incredibly soft, which is what I needed due to my sensory issues. I put them on and LOVED them even more. However, I wore them for the first time and noticed a flaw… when ever I walk, the pant leg turns. I will turn the pant leg to fix it, but as soon as I start walking again, the seem twists around. It drives me absolutely crazy, especially because of my sensory issues, seems can be a little uncomfortable. I am unsure I will ever wear the skirted leggings, and because of this, I am unsure that I will buy from Toonzshop again.

So in essence, the delivery process was less than ideal, but I finally got the package.

title: Good plus range, inconsistent sizing and high delivery/return costs
review: I like that boohoo have a good range of clothing in plus sizes however the sizing is all over the place, and the delivery fees combined with the return fees make it unaffordable to get the right size. I bought some coat options earlier in November, reordered smaller size on Black Friday (the price had gone up!) and the smaller size was still much too big. I can’t afford to spend any more on delivery not to mention the coat is now full price.  Both the larger and smaller size are my usual size and based on the size guide on their website. I could go down another 2 sizes (if I could afford another delivery).

title: Unsatisfactory Returns Policy
review: A week or more ago, I ordered a pair of shorts from Boohoo [Petite Paperbag Waist Shorts] and found them to be completely unlike what I thought I saw on the website; so I sought to return them. The return process is very easy, Boohoo has facilitated it well. However I was disappointed to learn that Boohoo does not refund postage. Almost half of the cost of the item I bought was the postage. I understand why Boohoo cannot refund postage without damage to their business --- however I think that future customers would do well to be aware that if they wish to get a refund for their item, the postage won't be refunded. Unfortunately it's often a significant portion of the cost.

title: Boohooman doesn’t refund returns
review: Been using this website for years and there are always problems when it comes to refunds. They tell you to wait 15 days when it only takes 3 for the returned item to get back to them. After the 15 days they still won’t issue a refund expecting you to have forgotten. If you don’t message them directly they most likely won’t issue a refund. Dishonest business. If you buy something make sure you won’t return it, if you do then write down every detail, put it in your calendars, set alarms because they won’t tell you. I once waited a whole month and a half and they didn’t say a thing until a checked and realised they never refunded me. Also if a parcel goes missing don’t bother asking for help, they don’t care. Thankfully customers service has been improving and you might get lucky to have help from a person with a working brain. They should just add a refund as store credit option and be done with it.

title: Late delivery, No refund
review: I placed an order on November 28th my bridesmaid dress was scheduled to be “expected” on December 9th, instead it has arrived on December 17th. I contacted “customer service” through Apple messages and asked for a reimbursement of the shipping fee because I find it utterly unreasonable that I paid $10 for shipping only to have it come later. Arguably a day or two late, but certainly not over a week late. This is what Kai the ai assistance had to say “Your order is currently marked as "dispatched" and was delivered on December 17th. Since the order status is not "cancelled" and there is no refund data available, I cannot process a refund for the shipping fee at this time.” I'm really upset, but I'm not requesting that my order be "cancelled." This was my first time shopping from Boohoo, and my friends had no issues with their orders—in fact, one of them had ordered a bridesmaid's dress the day after mine, and it arrived at the same address. Although the dress is beautiful and the material is just as described, I'm not happy with this purchase.

title: Bad customer service and overall a disappointing experience
review: Contacted customer service because I wore my corset top once and the wire of the bra part went through the fabric and was now sticking out, meaning there was no proper support. I had only worn it in the car on the way to the event and the moment I walked inside I noticed it was broken. I was pretty upset considering I paid € 40 for this top and expected it to be of better quality. It was a pain to be able to contact customer service. They decided to refund me € 20, rather than the full amount I paid or send me a new one. Dear Marirose, since you specifically asked if I could mention your name in the review, here you go. I am not happy with the way boohoo handled this issue. Marirose also suggested I fix this item myself, because apparently it’s up to the customer to take care of overpriced items that are made badly. Very disappointed with the overall boohoo experience. Shipping took ages, the product quality was sub par for the amount they’re charging, and I’m dissatisfied with how customer service handled this issue. Would not recommend. You could get the same type of quality on shein or temu for much cheaper.

Keeping one step ahead is what boohoo does best. Offering up-to-the-minute fashion across womenswear and menswear, boohoo brings you the very latest trends inspired by the catwalk, celebs and the street, alongside a huge range of basic styles to keep your wardrobe looking fresh every day.
You want it, we've got it. From our party-ready Night range to the laidback boohoo Blue line and our Plus and Petite collections, there's something for everyone with up to 100 new styles dropping daily. 
See it today, wear it tomorrow with our super-fast next day delivery service available in the UK. We also ship internationally to Europe, the USA, Australia and beyond so there's no excuse not to get something new.
title: Ive ordered from Boohoo before and…
review: Ive ordered from Boohoo before and never had an issue until the day it really matters. I leave for my destination wedding on September 22. I ordered a swimsuit cover up for the trip on 9/13 and paid $11 for it to be shipped within 4-7 business days.Then I get an email this morning saying it won't be here until September 26th! That's almost two weeks later! I looked further into it and I saw that it's being shipped from the UK!  SO annoying. I feel like I should be refunded $11 or given credit for the inconvenience.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Account holder for over a decade and happy to recommend
review: I have had a next account for over ten years and order several times a year. The reason I use NEXT is that I trust the delivery will be on time. On the odd occasion I have had an issue (such as Xmas deliveries going astray or not being delivered) customer service has been easy to contact and has resolved my issue. The website is easy to navigate and the account details simple to follow and track regarding payments and orders. I would happily recommend NEXT to family and friends.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Finding a swim suit for my wife to wear…
review: Finding a swim suit for my wife to wear at a local leisure club has never been easy, until now. The Next website provided excellent information to help me choose one which has proved to be just right and my wife is delighted with her Christmas gift! Thank you.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Absolutely love next!
review: Absolutely love next! Good quality clothing and easy ordering.   On occasion when I have to return on line orders to store, its such an easy process and refunds are swift too!

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Regular update on my online orders
review: Regular update on my online orders. Secured and easy checkout process on online orders. All stuff are lovely, durable, and fits well. Good customer service at till by staff team. Regular monthly statements, all stores are always clean and tidy. All items are easy accessible in store.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Good customer service experience
review: Wow. I am super impressed with Next. I had click and collect items waiting for me in store. I had an operation on my foot and wasn’t healing as quickly as anticipated. I called Next advising them that I couldn’t currently drive and asked them to hold on to the items for me as they were intended as Christmas presents. The advisor on the phone arranged to have everything sent out to me, via next day delivery, free of charge. I wasn’t expecting that but I was very appreciative as I was struggling to get a lift to store. Thank you, Next.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Hollie from Doncaster is the best
review: Over the last few days I have placed a purchase for my mum and, due to having been prompted to create an account, I did so and today when I requested a call-back, it happened almost immediately (which is pleasant) and I got put through to Hollie from Doncaster, who was excellent! She was kind, attentive and quick to put my mind at ease regarding collection!Only wish there were more people like Hollie :)Happy New Years anticipation ! :D

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: 🌸Lovely clothes🌸
review: The quality of the clothes is amazing,and you always know you are going to be delighted with what you have ordered.And your sales are brilliant🌸☺️🌸 My grandchildren look amazing in crew clothes and would fit in nicely in one of your adverts🫶 package well and arrived in good time Thankyou for these wonderful clothes ☺️

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Brilliant
review: Brilliant, I was really desperate for a present for a very special Grandson. And Tele next , two days before Christmas day to see if they could possibly deliver before Christmas I placed the order and Christmas Eve Evry delivered on behalf of next.I will always be grateful and would recommend them to.family and friends we have ordered many items before but as you can imagine this was a real winner. Thank you Next and Evry.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Erin L from Durham working York CC
review: I don't often shop at Next however I did recently purchase a Christmas gift online for collection in store. I've just popped in and probably was served by the most outstanding person this year. Erin, from Durham attending university in York.Simply, outstanding. Thank you

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Excellent service
review: Products came early, well packaged and although fragile were in perfect condition. Delivery driver polite and friendlyThank you all

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Not all of items have arrived yet
review: Not all of items have arrived yet, but the cushions and towels have and they are great quality. The only thing that let’s next down is their delivery. Safe place is ignored every time and it’s left on doorstep in all weathers…luckily no next orders ruined, but other items have been stolen and soaked with rain.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Simple and Straight-forward
review: I opted for click and collect for my Next purchase. Everything was simple and straight-forward to do. I had no problems. They communicated well and let me know when my order was ready to collect. I didn't have to wait long at all once actually in the store. Good experience overall.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Search facility needs improvement but overall good shopping experience…
review: The reason I dropped a star was because the inability to find what I actually was looking for even though I had a photo of the label but whilst hunting around found something else. Delivery to store was quicker than informed and pick up was quick considering the sale had started.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Great service.
review: I have always found that you get exactly what you have ordered, delivered quickly and efficiently. The wider range of clothes etc. available online is excellent.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Have had problems with goods being…
review: Have had problems with goods being delivered to wrong store, so it can take three days to get to store asked for, instead of next day delivery

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: A good item of clothing
review: A comfortable pair of jeans, but the delivery was delayed.  However, I will give a 4 star for keeping me informed of the delivery situation.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Good experience, would order this way again!
review: From time of my online order to time of delivery, everything went smoothly and according to what I was told when initially ordering. I would certainly purchase this way again.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Lovely light shade but a bit difficult…
review: Lovely light shade but a bit difficult to install on my own trying to balance on a stepladder holding the glass shade, droppers & lampholder.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: On line purchase
review: Purchased on line with no problems. Easy to navigate through the process. Choice of delivery and of store and of collection date. Next day is brilliant.  Items in good condition and just what I wanted. Always a good experience at Next.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: The service was okay
review: The service was okay. I have stopped shopping so much at Next since my credit was decreased without explanation. I now shop elsewhere since settling my account in full. Felt very disappointed

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: You try and help the planet!!!
review: When I placed my order on 25th December, I ordered 3 items. At the end of going through the routine, I was asked if all 3 items could be delivered together on the following Wednesday. This was perfectly fine as it was explained to me that it would save on omissions. What happened was that each item was delivered on separate days. So the omissions were 10 times worse.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: I’ve had a directory account for over…20 years
review: I’ve had a directory account for over 20 years and I can’t say anything negative. There have only been a couple of occasions when things haven’t been delivered as quickly as expected given the extra yearly charge. The person that delivers always does so efficiently and where it wouldn’t be stolen by any opportunists.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Great choice of products
review: Great choice of products. Good delivery although it was requested that items be delivered together to reduce packaging & this didn't happen.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Order delayed
review: Ordered on line to collect in store on Tuesday, message received stating delayed. Went in Thursday but told still not available.Rang customer service and lady was exceptionally helpful. She tried to call the store who cut her off as order should have been there. She then ordered the top again and got delivered directly to my home which arrived the next day. Thank you to customer service lady.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Ordering is easy and lots to choose…
review: Ordering is easy and lots to choose from. Its delivery that I cant count on.I generally don't get things delivered to the house anymore. The amount of times they didn't arrive, I was charged for them and then I had to go through the process of calling CS. I now get things delivered to the store which is not always convenient but at least I know they will arrive!

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Had to look for a member of staff...
review: The only thing that let our experience down was having to go and look for someone instore that could answer our questions and then take the order.After that, everything was as it should be. Friendly, attentive customer service and a fairly swift ordering process, as we've come to expect from Next.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: The order was easy to placestocked late delivery
review: The order was easy to place. But what was disappointing, was the fact the shirt was stated as being in stock but took over 2weeks to be delivered. Which meant I missed the appointment I ordered the shirt for.Regards Ken Baggottć

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Unfortunately not good C&C service.
review: Unfortunately - and unusually, the delivery process fell apart for this purchase. I had ordered it on C&C at my local store and received a text message with a code on the expected day. When I got there, there was no parcel. I returned the following day - a purposeful trip this time - still no parcel. On the day after that, an email and message arrived - still the same code, and this time the parcel was there 👍🏼.Also unfortunately, and our problem this time, the item ordered was much bigger than expected, so a reorder and return have been arranged - hoping it doesn’t take three visits this time.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Service with a smile
review: Always pleased with service from next be it online or instore, products are always delivered in a timely manner. Clothing is good quality as is Home store products.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Order
review: I love next. Always deliver on time, staff happy to help.  Love the home, clothing & to be honest everything Next has to offer.I know this is an extremely busy time for all involved at Next, however I was disappointed that I have not been kept up to date with an order  which is a Christmas present  I had to contact customer service to find out more information as to where my order is, to be told otd not on the warehouse, it's been delayed.  May be delivered next week, which is only Monday Tuesday possibly,  baring in mind it's Christmas day on Wednesday 😡 or after Christmas..not helpful as its a Christmas present & ordered a while ago

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Website ordering simple - service in collection store poor
review: The website was easy to navigate and I placed my order with no issues. I had to collect in store and from that point the simplicity disappeared. I was returning a gift from Christmas (jumper) with receipt but was told this was outside of the return window so I could only be given a gift card. I explained I had ordered 2 other jumpers (double my original spend) online and I was collecting this so could I just have a refund. They refused and the Manager refused so I asked could I spend the gift card online and they said no in store only even though it was ‘Next’ it was a return refund card. I asked if they sold the item I just bought online and they said yes so I had to buy the jumper in store with the ‘return refund card’ and then return the identical jumper that was in my online order and get a refund into my bank. This just made hard work and surely does not say much about Next’s carbon footprint. Won’t be shopping here again

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: I gave 3 stars because I bought /…
review: I gave 3 stars because I bought 2 jumpers recently £ 49 each . Couple days later they were less than half price in sale . So bit annoyed. Honestly though usually very happy with Next . Easy ordering , returns and very nice & friendly staff in Gapton Store . Happy New Year 🎊

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Bad service
review: I have been a Next customer for many years and have always found the service excellent. However, My recent experience is far from good. I have been let down on a delivery wanted for  Christmas with  absolutely no apology. Maybe the service is sliding?I have a delivery pass too.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Return error
review: Usually, I order, collect and all is super. However, on this occasion I picked up some of my order & when I went to pick up the rest of it (within the time as I had until 29 Dec) it was returned by the store, without any warning to me. I never got the chance to pick it up in the first place. Refund as not appeared either. I have just assumed it is down to the busy Christmas season. Just a little unfortunate on this occasion.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Pricing issue
review: Process of ordering and collection from store was straightforward. No queueing My only issue was the three products I ordered had labels on each £1 cheaper than I was charged Still awaiting a response from Next regarding this (it's Christmas so I'll give it a few more days before I chase up a reply )

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Did not arrive within the timescales…
review: Did not arrive within the timescales advised. This is always the case with Next. They need to update the website with realistic timescales. Very disappointing. People don't mind waiting 3/4 days as is expected when ordering online however when told it will be next day delivery and getting constant updates that delivery will be late a d waiting 3/4 days is very frustrating.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Better issue management in store is…
review: Better issue management in store is needed. Went into the store to pick up an online purchased item. The iPad that customer needs to use to check in for pick up item wasn't working. One of the customers informed the Staff, the immediate response of the Store to this problem definitely has room to improve. Many customers stood there did not know whether should go to the till for help or wait at the collection point. It is clearly a lack of issue management in the store. One girl from the till running around to help to get the preorder out, then a male staff suddenly asked, did anyone know the iPad wasn't working.. ( Honestly, after more than 20 min !). What made it even more frustrating was there were staffs in women section downstairs stood behind the till chatting. That means it wasn't a staff issue, it was a communication issue and issue management within the team Will avoid click and collection from store again.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Missing items from order
review: In the past week I have ordered two pairs of ladies pyjamas on separate days. On both occasions the tops were in the bag but not the bottoms! You should be more mindful when people return items they have ordered that both pieces should be returned not just half of it. I think it’s called stealing! Disappointed!

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Usually 5 star
review: Usually 5 star , probably not Nexts fault but the item I ordered didn’t get delivered I messaged Next they didn’t know what had happened I think it’s lost but still shows as being delivered on my account

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Nice candle
review: 3 stars as this was bought as a Christmas gift. Otherwise,  notifications were good and delivered on time at the revised date

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: The clothes are good but the packaging is awful!
review: We really like the baby clothes from next! They’re fun and bright and not as strictly gendered as other places. The big reason against 5 stars is the packaging. I ordered 10 items and they came in 7 or 8 separate plastic bags! I understand that some things come from different stores but some of these items were matching pyjamas that were personalised by the same people. If you’re shipping 10 items in 8 separate bags you could at least use the paper shipping bags. They’re baby clothes so they didn’t even take up a quarter of the bag. They’re not reuseable or recyclable at home. It’s just frustratingly wasteful.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Perfect items,  delivery poor by Evri
review: Items were perfect however I paid for next day delivery which didn't happen, took 3 days to arrive.  Next customer services were helpful in refunding the delivery cost promptly, however Evri failed with delivery times.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Great customer service in Didcot store but poor stock management
review: Great customer service in the Didcot shop but poor management / stock practices. I tried to buy two specific picture frames which I knew were in stock. It was a very important day and purchase for sentimental reasons so I made sure the shop had these specific items before setting off. When I got to the till to pay I saw there were large security stickers stuck down heavily onto the frames. I asked for them to be removed and sure enough all of the surface was pulled off. Of the three in stock only one was presentable enough to be given as a gift. In the obsession with shopliftters it seems counterintuitive to use materials that in themselves damage the products. I was left with only one item and was not able to give the present I wanted. The man in the store was very patient wth me and the situation and probably wondered why I was making such a fuss but I didn't want to burden him with the backstory of why this was important. Please think about the products and the waste that is caused by carelessly adding stickers and damaging them.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: I ordered my husband a jumper for…
review: I ordered my husband a jumper for Christmas and I couldn’t pick it up as I was at work all week When he picked it up it wasn’t in a bag so he saw his Christmas present, so there was no surprise for him at Christmas

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: The flowers did not really look like…
review: The flowers did not really look like the picture on the website. There were instructions to arrange them in the "hat box" but the stems would have to be very short to fit. The outer box was damaged on delivery and the inner tissue was soaked-looks like DPD didn't keep them upright in the van. The flowers were OK but the overall effect not as good as expected.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Delayed item with no ETA
review: Delayed item with no ETA. Live chat function not available each time I tried. Emailed via online form yesterday but I don't know how long response will be. Better information and quicker support would be helpful for Xmas shopping. Also item descriptions online could be improved

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Order not arrived
review: Nice item, quite expensive.Had text to say order at shop. Wasn't so had to make another trip to pick up......very frustrating and time wasting.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Would have had 5 stars
review: Would have had 5 stars, but at to go back the next day to collect other item.Thought that  the computer system would of been able to pick up my other deliveries

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: A bit disappointing
review: 2 gifts were fine but the pack of 2 nighties only contained 1. This meant an additional trip to return the packet, something I wanted to avoid at this busy time of year!

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Disappointing and frustrating delivery and item
review: Requested delivery on the Sunday. No parcel arrived but Evri marked it as delivered with no proof provided. I had to chase this with Evri and Next. Whilst dealing with this, Evri changed the status to delivered, with a note that it couldn’t be delivered. They later confirmed it would be delivered on Tuesday. This was delivered on the Tuesday, but Next still said it had been delivered on Sunday, and provided a picture taken on Tuesday, making me out to be a liar. Disgusting. The bedding itself, whilst lovely, is far too large for the duvet of the same size, and we are left with a foot at one side of just material, which the duvet doesn’t fill.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Website function is shocking.
review: Website function is shocking.Can’t pay using a gift card online. Contacted their customer services team, and all they did was send me a link saying ‘try this’ to enter a 10 digit pin which isn’t applicable to the gift cards. Waited 30 mins to be told this. Message back, no response. Warning: you need to create an account to buy anything off their website. It’s not just a simple find and buy like most retailers.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Ordered two T shirts well before…
review: Ordered two T shirts well before Christmas as presents for my grandson. One arrived quickly. After a week I received a message to say one had been delayed and would be about 5 days. Nothing after that, no T shirt, no messages. Eventually I cancelled the order. I was refunded but would have appreciated better communication to give me a fair chance of buying something else. Update: Following the reply from Next I have sent an email with the details.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Ordered for a birthday gift and item…
review: Ordered for a birthday gift and item was in stock and due to be delivered next day, never arrived! Then received an email to advise it would be delayed and would be delivered next day! Still didn’t receive for another 5 days, really disappointed

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Didaster
review: I ordered a 2 skirt pack - new. I got 1 and a hand written unsigned note saying I only got 1 as only 1 was returned!!?? It was a gift and I ended up only getting 1 skirt which was the same price as the 2pack! Also, because I'd bought on line the store couldn't refund my original payment - which I'm still waiting for. So essentially I've paid double for half of what I wanted! Not satisfactory at all.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Where is quality control?
review: I bought two mens tops, the same in different colours. When tried on the sizes were so different to each other we had to check the labels. We measured them and they were no where near the same size, not the first time neither.  I would expect this from a cheap retailer, but these tops were not cheap. This is happening more and more, seems to be no quality control at all. I seem to spend more time taking clothes back, costing me time and petrol.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Rubbish experience
review: Ordered on 18/12 chose next day delivery. Chased it on 19/12 to be told it was running late. Chased repeatedly and finally on 23/12 was told it was lost🙄 Had to phone next and get reordered and redelivered for next day delivery. Ridiculous that I had to chase multiple times for a parcel I paid for next day delivery.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Indirect racist profiling by a next staff
review: One of the staff in next shop Cambridge, the one around Andrew street has the worst form of customer service I have ever experienced. The guy was rude and a racist. I went to shop during the sales period on 27/12/2024 and the guy gave me an indirect profiling. I tried a suit and since it didn’t fit, I dropped it back like the other customer did. The guy came to meet me out of all the customers in the store at that time to go show him where I dropped the suit. He was not even matured enough to hide the look of disdain on his face. I had wanted to create a scene but I decided to act matured. I ended up spending over £150 to get some of the things I needed cos some of the ladies staffs are welcoming and helpful. That guy is not supposed to be working in an environment like next

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Not notified that parcel had arrived
review: I was not notified that my parcel had arrived in store, either on the app or by email. I had next day delivery. Tracking said it was still ‘planned delivery’ on a date that had been and gone. I went into the store four separate times to check and each time was told it was coming later. On the fourth time, the employee actually checked and found it had arrived on time but had not been logged.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Match description and photos to the actual item would be great!
review: I'm just fed up of ordering things and they don't live up to descriptions. Cardigans that are not super soft but as prickly as an army blanket. Pyjamas that don't fit a 7-8 but are big on a 9 year old. Items that are not designed for the size. If it is a size 22 sleeves and length should be a size 22 also. Tank tops should not show all the underside of your arms down to the bottom of your bra. They don't on the models, why is that?It feels like for every item I kept recently I took 3 similar back. Please don't suggest I shop in store. The chances of me finding a size 22 in the design I like are slim to none. In the past I've challenged members of staff in store to find a size 22 in anything.

description: Next.co.uk - Shop online for the latest fashion for women, men, children and homeware. Next day delivery and free returns.
title: Late delivery and incorrect depot
review: One of my deliveries and shies I ordered went to a wrong depo so arrived too late to wear . Was over week later2nd order due for delivery Monday was also delayed and only arrived today so I had to take trip to the shop in both to return them

The attendant (I don't recall his name) was friendly, courteous, knowledgeable and very helpful. He made arrangements for my swords to be shipped to my home in Texas, USA. I was surprised at how quickly they arrived and was very happy with the quality of the swords. My only issue  is that the scabbard for Anduril was a bit defective in that the sword would not fully sheath to the hilt. Something blocks the sword leaving 3-4 inches of sword unsheathed. In July of 2017 I emailed the Knight's Vault explaining the issue, however, I never received a response therefore the rating of 3 stars as opposed to 5

At LD Mountain Centre we pride ourselves on being one of the best independent outdoor stores in the UK. Over the years, we have supplied expeditions from pioneering ascents, led by Sir Chris Bonnington and the UK`s top Himalayan summiteer, Alan Hinkes OBE, to Duke of Edinburgh Award schemes and of course, those of us who simply love to escape the hustle and bustle at the weekend. 

With the Berghaus heritage and the reputation of LD Mountain Centre, we attract some of the best and most knowledgeable outdoor staff, all of whom, gain their knowledge and experience first-hand by getting out and using the kit, whether that's on skis, board, foot, bike or the end of a rope. All this means that here at LD Mountain Centre we can help and advise you so that you make the right choices for your outdoor clothing and equipment.

title: Great price, prompt delivery...
review: Bought my wife a Dale Norwegian sweater for Xmas from LD. Expensive but offered at a great price. Purchasing was smooth, delivery tracking good, delivery prompt. But the packing could have been a bit more robust - I wasn't at home for a couple of days when it was delivered and the postie left it wedged behind a water butt, in the endless 2024 rain. Considering the outer packaging was thick paper it survived getting soaked quite well. The inner packaging was a wafer-thin plastic bag. I left instructions to leave it in my greenhouse but I guess the postie didn't want to walk that far. Maybe make the outer packaging a bit less eco-friendly and a bit more product-protective.

review: Leggings are good, thick enough not to show everything. My only issue is with the VIP membership. Not the fact you get charged £50+ a month because you can skip it and it's easy enough to do. But, when you forget i just don't feel like you get your moneys worth. There's no option to spend half a credit when buying a cheaper item, so you have to either fork out the over £50 member credit on a cheaper item or spend money on top of it. There's continuously "new member deals" which way outweigh any benefits of being a member already. You also can't apply a credit and "top up" with cash for a more expensive item, nor spend 2 credits on a single item. I do like the way the clothes are advertised. They show several different sized models in a true light which is reflective of how these may look on the average human.Customer service is so-so. Nothing to write home about but have solved a few of the past queries.I think all said and done, if I was to find other bottoms I was comfortable wearing out and about, I'd jump ship.

You can cancel at “anytime” which is 4 days out of the month and if you miss it your stuck with another non refundable bill and “credit” . The prices for non members are hugely inflated which makes members feeling like they are getting a bargain however in reality it’s still over market value. Sizes are fairly small and stock levels are often crap. Would pass if I were you!

description: Co-founded by Adam Goldenberg, Don Ressler, & Ginger Ressler in 2013, Fabletics is a global active-lifestyle brand designed with everyone in mind. It’s the ultimate destination for the world’s best women's and men's lifewear and activewear. With millions of five-star-rated styles, ranging in sizes from XXS to 4X and inseams from short to long, there’s something for everybody—and every workout, no matter how you choose to sweat!
title: VIP thing a bit of a rip off
review: Signed up to the VIP thing when I bought some leggings in store and really wasn't impressed with any of the stuff on line.  Ended up with 2 credits where I'd forgotten to cancel, so have now spent them on stuff I wasn't really keen on just to get rid of them, and then cancelling the membership.  I liked the idea of being able to change the model to see how it might look on you, but they're all tall, so it's still hard to tell.  Plus they all seem to be pear shaped, and as an apple that doesn't help me.  To be honest the small models look good, and the bigger models looked bigger than me (and I asked others if that's how I looked) even when wearing the correct size, and to be honest that put me off as the photos are not flattering!

review: Honest Consumer Experience: Don't do business with swisstimepieces.co.uk unless you want to waste your time and money I am writing this because you should know my experience in dealing with  SwissTimepieces.co.uk, which had an add for a Longines Flagship Heritage Stainless Steel Automatic Mens Watch L47954782 posted on Chrono 24 (the site doesn't sell any products, sellers sell through the site - think ebay). The add was first posted in Octomber on Chrono24. The seller claimed to have the above mentioned watch, and offered fast delivery to my country.I contacted SwissTimepieces.co.uk directly about the watch add. We agreed on the details and the seller sent me a Paypal link to make the transaction. I made the payment for a Longines watch, for 995 british pounds, which the seller claimed to have on sale, in October 2017.After the seller confirmed the payment, the seller said the item would be delivered in 14 days. After some follow-up e-mails, the seller, in an e-mail on the 6th of November 2017, provided a second estimated date for delivery, 4 weeks from then. This delivery date also expired and still no item delivery (not even an estimate date).After some e-mails exchanged, the seller then provided December 2017 as a definitive delivery date. Finally, now very late December, the seller estimates (I highly emphasize "estimates") maybe January 2018 for a delivery date.This is unacceptable behaivour from an authorized English seller of Swiss watches, and for any company. 5 changed delivery dates, and this only after some serious e-mail correspondence from the buyer, is just unacceptable. I have waited a very long time for the item, which has caused me stress and anxiety. I would have never agreed to a "possible" January 2018 delivery, back when I made this transaction, in October 2017.The seller, SwissTimepieces.co.uk, posted the same add in December on Chrono24, claiming to deliver the watch to potential buyers in a few days. When I confronted the swisstimepieces.co.uk about this, they blamed Chrono24 for automated messages or delivery dates calculated automatically. I asked SwissTimepieces.co.uk to call me to talk about these issues. They told me they don't have a phone plan outside the UK. This was a big red flag for me, what business can't afford to call their customers? I just payed them more than a thousand euros. They claim to sell premium Swiss watches. But I digress. I gave the guy the benefit of the doubt, and told the seller I would call him, provided they give me a number to call.This was the second red flag, since SwissTimepieces.co.uk answered back that they don't have a phone line (!!!) and that they do all their "business" by appointement or throught online means. review: My partner and I chose to design our engagement ring using the Bespoke Design Package. While we are happy with the finished ring, there were some aspects of the design service that could be improved upon. We were quite apprehensive about ordering a ring online, and not being able to see the final design before purchase. This was one of the reasons why we decided to go with Lily Arkwright as we liked the idea of having a prototype ring to try on. We did find the design process to be a little inflexible and while we could tweak our design numerous times, we weren't able to make significant modifications to our design (we asked to see our setting without the side stones and were told this wasn't possible as this would be going in a different design direction). The renders were also not overly realistic and we were told the setting and band would appear a lot 'chunkier' in the visuals than in real life. The prototype was also only of the band and setting so it wasn't possible to get a good idea of what the ring would look like when the stones were in place. We were not sent any photos of the finished ring prior to it being posted to us. Unfortunately, once we received the ring we noticed that the band differed from the final design we had agreed upon. We alerted customer service to this issue and were able to post the ring back to be altered. While the customer support team handled this matter efficiently, this delay meant my partner had to postpone his planned proposal.

title: Customer service can do better about customer satisfaction.
review: I bought an expensive Omega special edition watch for my brother as a gift - he is a Bond fan and likes collecting. I expected the basic items to come with the watch, namely the watch's hang tag with its serial number on it. When I was told I was not getting one, I insisted on it. I was told that Finnies don't keep hang tags and their policy is to not give them out. While I disagree with this having checked with Omega (Swatch Group) colleagues who have all confirmed that the AD should give the customer the hang tag and that the AD does not have any reason to withhold it. I do understand that it is Finnies' policy not to include the tag (although unsure why). When I further insisted on this and expressed my disappointment, I was told that I can return the watch if I like. I was disappointed. However,  I must appreciate Jason from Finnies whose quality of service and helpful attitude has compensated for this. Finnies has been a well-established family-owned business in Aberdeen, and has gained popularity in the UK. It would be nicer if they would warn the customer about what they are walking away with, BEFORE the purchase, so that the customer's expectation is managed. Trust is a delicate thing. Both Finnies and the end-customer can work together to build and benefit from a long-lasting relationship. A little bit of goodwill can go a long way in these tough economic times. Thank you, Finnies for the great watch and gift wrap. They would have got six stars if they would take a little more care about the small things that can make a big difference to the end-consumer. Just my thoughts.

title: Really disappointed with my experience…
review: Really disappointed with my experience this time with Finnies. Went in to replace a lost pearl earring which my partner had given me 2yrs previously. Initially I walked out with a single earring which was what I wanted however on my second wear two weeks after purchase the pearl came away from the stem. I went in and dealt with Amy who was fantastic and awaited her phone call on the best cause of action. She gave me several options (replace, repair or refund), as I really loved my original earrings wanted the replace option. I went in again to pick up my replacement to be told by a different person that that was not an option and the earring would need to be sent away and repaired under warranty. I was also told i needed to be careful with how i treat them to prevent breakage. Reluctantly I accepted this the repair.  3 weeks later I recieved a message asking me to call finnies to be advised of the repair costs. By this time I was incredibly frustrated and angry as the earring was supposed to be repaired free of charge. After speaking to Finnies over the phone, I recieved a call back to apologise as the wrong information had been given and the earring was repaired and I should go in to view. I was told if I wasn't happy with the repair that I could either choose a replacement or get a refund. When I went in I was told the earring hadn't been repaired and I could choose a replacement. At no point was I told there would I have to pay extra. I said to the lady i wanted the same as what i previously had as i really loved them. After selecting she advised me the full cost of a pair, after a short discussion she then advised I would have to pay the difference between buying the initial replacement pearl earring and the new pair. As I was incredibly annoyed with 4 trips into Finnies with my two children in toe, having to pay for parking each time and dealing with 7 different people I paid the difference and left. I didn't need another pair as I still had one, which Finnies had as they were going to match the repair against it and if it had of been my intention to buy a replacement pair I would of done this on my first trip in and saved myself all the hassle. At least Finnies managed to get another sale however that will be the last one from us.

Just recently I got an email advertising the latest sale items and to my surprise the boots were the only ones available in my size! So I treated myself. Still very expensive compared to other brands but I have a pair of white trainers which I bought in the sale from Air&Grace and absolutely adore them and so comfy. So far I haven’t worn my new boots out of the house as waiting for the weather to get cold! They look lovely, if a little hard leather which I think will need breaking in a bit.

If I could submit a photo I would, its a small part but critical.  Update.  I have been asked to remove a member of staff's name, so I have. I politely thanked them for their time and said we went ahead with another ring company. He mentioned that we took all of their time and "used them". I apologised that he felt like that and said the rings he showed me were way over our budget. He wasted his own time by showing us rings that were way above our budget. Despite him arriving late for the appointment and juggling another set of clients which took more time, I still gave him good feedback to family and friends after the consultation. He said I didn't have the decency to follow up with him. Sorry but am I making the sale or are you? As a seller, it's your role to follow up with clients. But 10 days later was simply too late. I don't have to explain why I went with another company.His messages started becoming sour and patronising as the conversation went on. Mentioning the small things like me asking for a pass on the day (which I asked many hours ahead) and the fact I didn't complete the "form". I told him all the details over the phone. I assumed he took notes. The form had sections to add in "links". Sorry brother but how am I going to add in any website links of the rings I like if you don't send me the website? I had to remind him to send me the website to look at prior the visit. He also mentioned the fact that I had a notepad with me to take notes.  He stated that "notepad tells us you're going to take notes so think about it later". This was a weird comment to make since bride notepads are common to use. I don't know if that comment was said to embarrass me.The most disappointing part of all of this is that he contacted the family friend who referred us and back chatted about the experience. There is no need to be discussing client appointments with other people. This is very unprofessional. All they had to say was ‘thank you for the update and we wish you the best’. I would NOT recommend them after this experience.@Decoris - I suggest you are careful with your response if you want to respond because twisting my words won't work if I have the conversation saved. I won't name and shame the person we dealt with. Hopefully you take this on board and change your attitude.

title: Initially Good but Ultimately Deflating

I bought the ring over the phone a few days later, and asked the store to keep it so as I could pick up closer to my wife’s birthday, since it is to be a surprise.What was unfortunate was that when I subsequently returned to pick up the ring there was a 40% store-wide discount which exceeded the discount I had been given at the time of purchase; the store were apparently unable to made good the difference by way of partial refund. I was given a credit note - which I’m unlikely to use as I don’t buy much jewellery - and a phone conversation about the notional future purchase of matching earrings was *really* not what I wanted at that point.I would have been more philosophical had I taken the ring home at the point of purchase, but to leave the store today with the ring knowing I’d overpaid compared to the price in the window meant the overall experience left me somewhat deflated.

title: Not What I Expected
review: Unfortunately I appear to have visited this shop on a bad day.  I had been left various pieces of jewellery from the 1900’s which had been valued over twenty years ago for insurance purposes and I wanted to know whether it was worth selling or re-valuing and keeping in the meantime.  The answers I got were Mr Harold doesn’t really buy jewellery - although it states it on the sign outside the shop.  I do appreciate that the antique market may be flooded with items at this time but Mr Harold doesn’t have time to value jewellery either - although it says it in the sign outside the shop.  I could, however, take photos and send them in and they’d get around to it sometime - possibly when they’ve got nothing better to do.  No thank you Mr Harold, I have now found a wonderful antique jewellers local to me who have been extremely helpful abd have given me the advice I expected to receive when I came into your shop.  It might also be an idea to change your signage outside your shop as it is rather misleading, if you don’t have the time or the staff to do valuations you shouldn’t really be advertising it as a service.

title: Rude, exploitative and unethical jewellers
review: My husband bought me a smoky quartz ring for my 30th birthday present back in September. A week or so ago I noticed the prong on the bottom left of the ring was slightly raised and was catching on things. I decided to take it in to the same shop it was purchased in to get it repaired. I went in with my mum and was told by the owner of the shop herself it would be, and I quote (my mum can attest to this too) "a small fee". Thinking it would be along the lines of £20-30 for such a small bit of work, having paid £40 for a resizing a few doors down, I took my pick up slip, and left.I went to collect my ring today and was told that it was going to cost me "£125, if you're happy with that?". I immediately said no, I wasn't happy to pay that, and queried why bending a prong back into place cost so much. The lady who served me jumped in and explained that £75 had been added on for a clean and polish. A service I had neither been advised of or requested. When I rebutted this she said it's added on 'automatically' and would I be happy to 'just' pay £75 for the clean and polish? Why would I pay for something I didn't want? When did it become okay to do things to peoples possessions without their consent? This is where it started to get even more awkward.She called her manager over (the husband of the lady who served me, and the co-owner of the shop I presume?) who told me that, and again I quote, "something must have happened to the ring" because when it reached the workshop "it was actually the two prongs that needed pressing down".Firstly, when I brought the ring in and it was assessed by your wife, it was only the one prong. So are you admitting my ring was not handled with care whilst in your possession? Or are you suggesting your wife got it wrong?Secondly, if a repair was going to be more extensive and costly than originally anticipated, would it not be prudent to call the customer? Apparently not, as when I kept asking why I hadn't been contacted to obtain permission he replied, "if we had to call every customer about things like that we would be on the phone all day". It seems that it's simply too arduous a task to call customers and ask their consent before going to town on their possessions. There were about five staff members sat in the shop at the time, and none of them looked particularly busy - might I suggest you assign one of them the task of making courtesy calls to customers?Thirdly, throughout this exchange I remained polite. I said multiple times that as I had never met or had a conversation with any of these people, how could I possibly be blaming them personally and that surely they could see a £125 charge was insane. The blonde lady who initially asked me for £125 had an unnerving grimace on her face the entire time I was in the shop (unsure if smiling is how she deals with awkward interactions, or if she was trying to intimidate me). She also kept interrupting me saying "what did you think it was going to cost then?" "we clearly have a different idea over what a reasonable charge is". At this point I told her there was no need to talk to me like that, and that I didn't work in the jewellery trade, so how could I possibly answer that question? All I know is that £125 is not 'a small fee', and that common sense would suggest that a clean and polish for £75 needs consent to go ahead.Finally, when we told the manager that our idea of a 'small fee' for such a small task was between £20-30, he kept saying "we wouldn't make anything if we charged that". Respectfully, your costs are not my concern. What IS concerning however is that your unethical practices are in direct conflict with Section 50 (1) a and (2) b of the Consumer Rights 2015 Act. I suggest you go and have a read.We offered to pay a reasonable fee for the prong repair, but they clearly just wanted us gone at this point and the blonde lady shoved my ring into my hand with a "here's your ring!". The door was wide open the entire time and when we left, we noticed there were a few people who had clearly been listening in to the conversation. Truthfully, I hope our interaction served as a warning to people potentially considering purchasing from you. In response to your reply - that’s funny, because you didn’t say any of this at the time so it very much feels like you’re now trying to save face. Instead, you stood there stuttering making both of us feel like criminals and didn’t once offer any apology for the ‘miscommunication’. You’ve only offered one now because I left a bad review. You ask “what more could we have done?” Perhaps treat me like a human being and apologise? Oh and to add insult to injury, my ring is still bent out of shape and looking at photos of when I received the ring, the prong has always been dodgy and the entire setting of the ring looks misaligned. Not even 24 hours after having it ‘repaired’ and it’s still picking up bits of fluff and snagging.

description:
TOG24 stands for “Truth Over Glory Everyday”. We’re not about the “Glory” side of the outdoors; Planting flags on mountains or skiing down sheer ice walls, we’re about the “True” outdoors that everybody can be involved with; walking with friends to the pub or skiing with the family to a bar.

Based in the Spen Valley town of Heckmondwike, initially produced footwear, branched into sports bags and football kits in the 70's before finally landing on waterproofs and fleeces. As the brand grew in popularity skiwear and casual clothing were added. We manufactured all our clothing in the head office we still own today, however, to ensure we stayed competitive and to keep our doors open, it was with a heavy heart that we began producing overseas. Whatever the product was, it had to fit into our motto...

TOG24 are a product of our location in the Spen Valley, Yorkshire; we try to do things right, we don’t believe in the marketing hype that’s out there and everything we make represents quality and value for your hard earned pound. And while we no longer manufacture here (that stopped in 2010) all our products are still proudly designed in the Spen Valley

TOG24 began with the factory shop in Heckmondwike. Originally carpeted in off cuts of fleece and selling seconds and ends of lines out of cardboard boxes, the store did so well that we stopped trying to sell TOG24 to other people’s shops and set up our own chain of stores. TOG24 now sells from over 60 outlets across Britain and Ireland, (and for the biggest bargains you can still visit us at our original factory shop in Heckmondwike).

Could the manufacturers please take note?! Otherwise, so far, so good...

review: I’ve ordered from here a couple of times. The orders have always arrived quickly and the website has been easy to use.However the ‘sale’ is a scam. Both of the orders I’ve made previously have been for the same jacket, just in different colours. The first order was earlier in the year around spring/summer time where the jacket was on sale for £39. I then ordered it again in a ‘Black Friday sale’ for the same price. I kept checking the website throughout the year and the jacket was always on a sale price. I’ve never seen it at the supposed full price of £85. I did contact TOG24 to question when and how long it was at full price for and they’ve not responded to any of my emails.

title: Slow sale, not much communication, except trustpilot review requests...
review: So, I sold a watch with BQ (Tudor Black Bay 925). On the upside, it sold! On the downside it took over 12 months.Long story, but tried to sell originally with Watchmaster (Feb '23) who went insolvent. BQ took over (May '23). Sometime during the transfer the watch was damaged, though BQ fixed it for free as a gesture of goodwill.Contact wasn't great with BQ. Lots of requests to call back which didn't happen. Called them to suggest we reduce the price (Autumn 23). The watch itself is advertised primarily on chrono24.Eventually it sold (May 24) to a 'frequent customer' for well below asking price. Not BQs fault exactly, but a general downturn in the market. They did reduce their commission so I got a round figure payment. My payment from them went through fine, as agreed.Since sale, contact has substantially increased! They want trustpilot reviews: Emails, a call, 3 messages, offer of free tickets to an event in the space of a week.It's the first watch I've sold, so not much to benchmark against. Contact was limited, and would have preferred something more active / proactive and a quicker sale. Obviously leaving an expensive watch with a random internet company is a little worrisome, so at least it didn't go 'missing'
